en: Colorized historic view of a European city square with a central open plaza lined with young trees and outdoor café tables. Surrounding the square are multi‑story buildings in late 19th–early 20th century style, including a prominent white corner building with ornate gables and towers. A tall column or monument stands in the square, and a green-and-white electric tram runs along the street in the foreground. The distant background shows low hills. At the top center is printed text indicating the city and square name.
